Modernized periodic syntax and phrasing ('a problem to the learned', 'but the French compound', 'Besides'); split long sentences.
Recast 1851 word order ('there were found in this ambergris') and 'afterwards turned out' into modern syntax.
Modernized 'owing to my anxiety to repel', 'slanderous aspersion', passive inversion and 'slatternly'.
Recast 1851 passive/periodic sentence ('so dearly purchased, was duly brought', 'regularly gone through').
Modernized 'concreted', 'unctuous', 'molifier', 'serpentine and spiralise' and the exclamation series.
Modernized 'Would that', 'conceit of attainable felicity', 'the fancy' and split the periodic sentence; kept the Job phrase 'In thoughts of the visions of the night' as an allusion.
Modernized 'First comes ... so called', 'ere going to the mincer' and 'portable oblongs'.
Modernized 'bestowed upon', 'participating ... in its unctuousness', 'As its name imports', 'bestreaked', 'Spite of reason', 'conceive'.
Modernized 'so called', 'properly belonging to', 'incidentally used' and 'designates'.
Recast 1851 descriptive syntax ('are planted', 'of a peculiar strength, fitted to sustain', 'two in number', 'many confidential communications are carried on') into modern sentences.
Replaced dangling 1851 participle construction, 'prevented from communicating itself' and 'kept replenished' with modern syntax.
Modernized 'Here be it said', 'staple fuel', 'considerable of its unctuous properties', 'Would that', 'Hindoo', 'funereal pyres'; split the long closing sentences.
Modernized 'We were clear from the carcase', 'forked forth', 'issuing from', 'bore down upon' and the periodic Canaris sentence.

Modernized the scene-setting sentences ('now afforded', 'Standing on this were', 'Here lounged the watch', 'capricious emblazonings') while keeping the rhythm and every image of the long closing sentence.

Modernized 'Starting from', 'smote', 'spite of all this', 'it seemed but a minute', 'Uppermost was the impression', 'crazy conceit', 'thought I', 'Lo!', 'fronting' and the verbless closing exclamation.
Modernized Ishmael's own 'Give not thyself up ... lest it invert thee' and the 'alike ... and' construction; Solomon quotation kept verbatim (decision 8); italic 'i.e.' rendered without underscores.
Replaced 1851 conditional inversion 'Had you descended' and 'a chiselled muteness' phrasing with modern syntax.
Undid inverted opening 'Already has it been related', 'descried', 'surtout', 'rehearsing', 'striking them down' and 'profundities'; split the long periodic sentence.
Modernized 'At length', 'This done' and 'hermetically closed' phrasing.
Modernized 'else all things are little worth', 'but an empty cipher' and the participial opening.
Modernized 'whence', 'amidst', the 'Nor, though ... nevertheless' construction and 'wanton'; kept the Pactolus gloss.
Modernized 'It so chanced', 'a most wealthy example', 'unwaning clime', 'Zoned by those letters' and 'cabalistics'.
Modernized Ahab's grammar ('Methinks', 'but mirrors back', 'aye', 'but six months before', ''tis fit') while keeping his cadence, repetitions and imagery.
Modernized Starbuck's 'mouldings', 'marked the coin inspectingly', 'girds us round', 'would fain' and 'I will quit it'.
Modernized 'So cried Ahab', 'bearing down under the stern', 'or thereabouts', 'roundabout' and 'broidered'.
Modernized 'See you this?' and the participial 'withdrawing it from the folds'.
Modernized 'without quitting his little craft', 'presented itself', 'contrivance peculiar to the Pequod', 'unsupplied with the kindly invention' and 'abjectly reduced'.
Modernized 'It has before been hinted', 'untoward circumstance that befell him', 'cleets', 'bethink them' and 'bannisters'.
Modernized 'I was ignorant of', 'could only trim dish', 'Presently up breaches' inversion.
Modernized 'thus familiarly pointed out', 'nothing specific visible, to denote', 'straightway went on to do his captain's bidding'.
Modernized 'now cried Ahab, who thus far had been' and 'by-play'.
Modernized Bunger's 'thinks to terrify by feints', 'making believe swallow', 'in good earnest', 'a twelvemonth', 'd'ye see', 'have a mind to pawn', keeping his comic pomposity.
Recast the participial chain and 'commanded ... to stand by to lower' into modern syntax.
Modernized 'In vain the English Captain hailed him' inversion and 'face set like a flint to his own'.
Modernized 'All honor to ... therefore', 'exists to the present day' and 'doubtless ... must long ago have'.
Modernized 'minds me of', 'a very fast sailer', 'they were all trumps', 'at the rate of ten gallons the hour', 'tars', 'by and by', 'forecastle scuttle', and split the long run-on sentences.
Transcribed provision list: spelled out 'lbs.' as 'pounds' for modern readers; items, figures, measures and Melville's aside kept, with the reviewers' brief glosses of firkins and ankers.
Modernized 'parchingly dry in the reading; not so in the present case'.
Modernized 'studious digesting', 'incidentally suggested to me', 'touching the probable quantity', 'I impute it', 'unctuous natures', 'Esquimaux', 'pledge each other in bumpers of train oil'.

Modernized 'prosecuted', 'say, and reckoning', 'exclusive of', 'fuddled as one might fancy', 'be it remembered', 'grievous loss might ensue'; untangled the long periodic calculation into separate sentences.
Modernized 'But no more', 'high livers', 'For, say they'.
Modernized 'for that rare knowledge I am indebted', the dangling 'For being at Tranque ... when attached to' and 'retired palm villa'.
Modernized 'Chief among these latter', 'plumage-like, tufted droopings seemed his verdant jet', 'fathom-deep enfoldings' and the periodic 'When ... then' sentence.
Modernized 'life-restless loom', 'assuming greener, fresher verdure', 'wived' and 'begat him', keeping the weaving imagery and the Life/Death chiasmus.
Modernized the inverted clauses ('saw the skull an altar', 'more I marvelled', 'To and fro I paced'), 'object of vertu', 'naught was there but bones'.
Modernized 'I shall now proceed to set down', 'as in my wild wanderings', 'crowded for space', 'did not trouble myself', 'congenial admeasurement'.
Modernized 'lay before you a particular, plain statement, touching' and 'whose skeleton we are briefly to exhibit'.
Modernized 'divers other parts', 'unobstructed bones', 'embraces so very large a proportion', the chain of 'as' clauses, and 'gain a complete notion'.
Modernized 'not a little resembled', 'new-laid upon the stocks', 'the keel is otherwise, for the time, but'.
Modernized 'to begin from the neck', 'each successively longer', 'bore a seemly correspondence', 'beams whereon to lay'.

Modernized 'could not but be struck anew with the circumstance', 'mould of his invested form', 'measured but little more', 'conveyed half of the true notion', 'for some way', 'Still more, for the ample fins'.
Modernized 'forty and odd', 'in width something less than', 'cannibal urchins', 'Thus we see how that'.
Modernized 'How, then, with me', 'chirography', 'penning my thoughts', 'outreaching comprehensiveness of sweep', 'Such, and so magnifying, is the virtue', 'many there be who have tried it'.
Modernized 'bestowed upon it the name', the absolute 'some specimen bones of it being taken', the verbless sentence, 'furnishes but little clue', 'fully invested body', 'the mutations of the globe'.
Modernized 'upon investigation we find', 'superior in magnitude', 'embracing a distinct geological period prior to man', and the inverted 'of the whales found ...' clause.
Modernized 'Of all the pre-adamite whales yet exhumed' inversion, 'Whereas, we have already seen, that', 'on whalemen's authority', 'near a hundred feet'.
Modernized 'Assuredly', 'if we are to credit', 'embraced acres of living bulk', 'setting down ... at', 'so late as'.
Recast the dangling participial periodic sentence ('Comparing ... ; in such a comparison an irresistible argument would seem furnished') and 'overspread'.
Modernized the long 'Though ... and though ... yet' periodic sentence, 'not a good lifetime', 'peremptorily forbids', 'slain', 'if need were, could be statistically stated'.
Modernized 'we are to consider, that from the presumed great longevity ... therefore', 'what that is, we may soon gain some idea of', 'yielding up'.

Stage direction modernized from 1851 participial telegraphese ('which joist is firmly fixed in the vice', 'lying about', 'Forward, the red flame ... is seen'); parenthetical layout kept, italics dropped per convention.
Modernized the deferential period idiom 'If the captain pleases, I will now mark the length'.
Modernized Ahab's 'No fear' and 'What's Prometheus about there?'
Modernized 'Um-m', 'I do deem it now a most meaning thing', 'animated them with fire', 'This must be the remainder the Greek made the Africans of', 'pedlar'.
Modernized 'Hold', 'while Prometheus is about it', 'after a desirable pattern', 'Imprimis', 'take the order, and away'.
Modernized 'I should like to know' and the aside's word order; aside kept as a stage direction.
Modernized 'Truly, sir, I begin to understand somewhat', 'on that score', 'how that', 'if it be really so'.
Modernized Ahab's 'thy live leg', 'Where thou feelest tingling life; there ... do I', 'Is't a riddle?' while keeping his cadence.
Modernized 'Truly, sir', 'I must calculate over again', 'I think I didn't carry a small figure'.
Modernized 'standing debtor', 'Cursed be that mortal inter-indebtedness', 'given bid for bid', 'Prætorians', 'compendious vertebra', keeping Ahab's elevation; stage direction kept.
Modernized 'According to usage', 'lo! no inconsiderable oil', 'Much concern was shown', 'this unfavourable affair'; footnote asterisk kept in place.
Modernized 'drawing nigh', the 'between which lies' inversion, 'oriental archipelagoes' phrasing and the long participial description; kept the reviewers' modern geographic forms (decision 7).
Modernized Starbuck's 'more oil than we may make good in a year' and 'What we come twenty thousand miles to get'.
Modernized Ahab's 'Begone!', 'I'm all aleak', 'Aye!', 'who can find it ... or how hope to plug it', 'I'll not have', keeping his leak-imagery rhetoric.
Modernized the convoluted 'daring so strangely respectful ... every way seeking to avoid the slightest outward manifestation of itself' and Starbuck's 'pass over in thee'.
Modernized 'duly planed and fitted', 'lightly shouldered', 'inquiring whether they were ready for it yet in that direction'.
Modernized 'Overhearing ... Queequeg ... commanded', 'nor was there any denying him; seeing that', 'for evermore', 'ought to be indulged'.

Modernized 'long regarded the coffin with an attentive eye', 'ranged round the sides within', the absolute 'a piece of sail-cloth being rolled up', 'entreated ... that he might make trial of its comforts, if any it had', 'told one', 'signed to be replaced'.
Modernized 'lay with closed eyes' and 'the sick man was replaced in his hammock'.
Modernized 'had at an early period of the voyage excited', 'to the importunity of their persisted questionings', 'so it came to pass'.
Modernized 'Why tell the whole?', 'grew more and more between', 'glitteringly gazing', 'thither', 'in crape', 'unreverenced', keeping the rhythm of the cumulative sentence and every image.
Modernized Ahab's word order ('forge me first, twelve rods for its shank'), keeping the imperative rhythm.
Modernized 'This done', 'stayed his hand', the long absolute construction 'Perth passing ... the forge shooting', 'hems', 'seemed invoking'.
